sanskrit:
अथैतदप्यशक्तोऽसि कर्तुं मद्योगमाश्रितः ।
सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं ततः कुरु यतात्मवान् ॥ १२-११॥
iast:
athaitadapyaśakto’si kartuṃ madyogamāśritaḥ
sarvakarmaphalatyāgaṃ tataḥ kuru yatātmavān 12-11
translation: If you are unable to do even this, then taking refuge in Me, self-controlled, renounce the fruits-of-all-actions.
